title: Maximum Students Taking Exam
description: Find the maximum number of students that can take the exam in an m x n room without any two students sitting in adjacent seats (including diagonally).
pseudocode:
1. masks = valid row configurations
2. dp = new Array(m).fill(0).map(() => new Map())
3. for row in m:
4.   for curr_mask in masks:
5.     for prev_mask in dp[row-1]:
6.       if is_compatible(curr_mask, prev_mask):
7.         dp[row][curr_mask] = max(dp[row][curr_mask], dp[row-1][prev_mask] + bits(curr_mask))

steps.note: Initialize valid row masks for 2x2 grid. Row 0: [0, 1, 2]. Row 1: [0, 1, 2].
Assigning weights: mask 0 (0 students), mask 1 (1 student), mask 2 (1 student).
Processing Row 1. Compare with Row 0 masks. Ensure no diagonal adjacency.
Calculated max students for Row 1 using compatible previous masks.
